name: team code filter under week row axis resolves through the player bridge CTE
description: Regression for league 63ecc8817. A filter on a team-identity column under player row_grain emitted `player_years_weeks_teams.team_code` and failed with 42703 -- the three bridge CTEs expose the player team set as a `teams text[]` array and have no scalar team column. The column definition was already correct; where-string.mjs did not forward query_context into main_where or is_where_column_array, and is_player_row_grain(undefined) is falsy -- a VALID branch -- so both hooks emitted the team-grain form. Pins the array-overlap predicate against the week bridge. The reproducing view was /u/d25875e3363f78d5902d5f257a5c1cb3.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2025]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2025 AND nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1, 2)), "player_years_weeks_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, week, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2025::int AS year, g.week, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2025 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2025) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "t65d884ca6c5efe3905baec6497500380" as materialized (select COALESCE(passer_pid, ball_carrier_pid, target_pid) as pid, "nfl_plays"."week", SUM(epa) as total_expected_points_added_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."nfl_week_id" in ('2025_REG_WEEK_1', '2025_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2025) group by "nfl_plays"."week", COALESCE(passer_pid, ball_carrier_pid, target_pid)), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2025::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2025 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2025) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2025::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2025 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2025) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2025_REG_WEEK_1', '2025_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2025)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2025_REG_WEEK_1', '2025_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2025))) as "g") select "player"."pid", "t65d884ca6c5efe3905baec6497500380"."total_expected_points_added_from_plays" AS "total_expected_points_added_from_plays_0", player.first_name, player.last_name, "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" inner join "player_years_weeks_teams" on "player_years_weeks_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_weeks_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_years_weeks_teams"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "t65d884ca6c5efe3905baec6497500380" on "t65d884ca6c5efe3905baec6497500380"."pid" = "player"."pid" and t65d884ca6c5efe3905baec6497500380.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player_years_weeks_teams.teams::text[] && ARRAY['NE']::text[] group by "t65d884ca6c5efe3905baec6497500380"."total_expected_points_added_from_plays", player.first_name, player.last_name, "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 10
